<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This is the well-known upstream `xvfb-run` shell script (Debian/X.Org, mirrored by T2 SDE), a standard helper that starts an Xvfb virtual X server, runs a caller-supplied command against it, and cleans up. Every operation in the file serves that stated purpose.

There are no network requests of any kind — no curl, wget, git, or socket operations.
